title: Controlled outer terms of the successor coefficient-filtration triangle
statement: Let X be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, (A,I) an adic coefficient datum, φ the coefficient isomorphisms compatible with both consecutive quotient maps and the completed scalar projections, and M an arbitrary derived object over the completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose each constant quotient realization preserves zero morphisms. Fix an etale chart V, a <= b, and n >= 0. Suppose the residue and nth reductions have finite-perfect local models in [a,b] in the precise predicate of [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Set B=A/I^(n+2), R₀ to the actual successor ring sheaf, and K to the actual successor derived reduction. Let P(F) for an R₀-module sheaf mean that, for every etale W -> V, a covering sieve on W trivializes F as the restriction of ordinary scalar extension along φ_(n+1) of the lifted constant sheaf of a finite B-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. Then there exists a distinguished triangle T of derived R₀-module sheaves, an isomorphism T.obj₂ ≅ K, and the following outer-term controls: the restrictions to V of H^q(T.obj₁) and H^q(T.obj₃) are zero for q outside [a,b], and P holds for every H^q(T.obj₁) and every H^q(T.obj₃). No cohomological property of T.obj₂ is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain the distinguished coefficient-layer triangle with its three isomorphisms to the explicitly constructed layer, successor, and restricted previous objects.
Use the residue finite-perfect model to compute finite bounded algebraic local homology models of the explicit first object.
Use the previous finite-perfect model, by restriction of coefficients, to compute finite bounded algebraic local homology models of the explicit last object.

Apply the proved general local-homology-model theorem to both objects. Its finite-set cycles-and-quotient argument establishes finite homology, and separatedness descends vanishing. Transport both bounds and every local model across homology and overFunctor applied to the endpoint isomorphisms. Keep the supplied middle isomorphism. This is the required triangle with both outer controls.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteQuotient_cohomology_filtration_triangle
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hresidue : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M 0 V a b) (n : ℕ)
    (hprevious : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M n V a b) :
    let B := A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1)
    let R₀ := completedAdicFiniteRing X d (n + 1)
    let K := (completedAdicQuotientReduction X d (n + 1)).obj M
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ (n + 1))).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    ∃ T : Triangle (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀)),
      T ∈ distTriang _ ∧ Nonempty (T.obj₂ ≅ K) ∧
        (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
          IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj T.obj₁)) ∧
          IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj T.obj₃))) ∧
        DerivedCategory.homologyProperty P T.obj₁ ∧
        DerivedCategory.homologyProperty P T.obj₃
